input: Deep clean the oven and stovetop burners

gold.taskTitle: Deep Clean Oven and Stovetop Burners
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to thoroughly deep clean their oven interior and stovetop burners to remove grease, grime, and baked-on residue.

questions.title: What type of oven do you have?
questions.description: Knowing whether it is gas, electric, or convection affects the cleaning method and safety steps involved.

questions.title: Does your oven have a self-clean function?
questions.description: If the oven has a self-clean cycle, that changes whether manual scrubbing is needed or just finishing touches.

questions.title: What cleaning products do you currently have available?
questions.description: Knowing whether the user has commercial oven cleaner, baking soda, vinegar, or other supplies determines if a shopping trip is needed.

questions.title: How long has it been since the last deep clean?
questions.description: The level of grease and baked-on buildup will determine the intensity of scrubbing and soaking time required.

questions.title: Are the stovetop burners gas grates or electric coils?
questions.description: Gas grates and electric coils require completely different removal and cleaning techniques.

questions.title: Do you have a specific deadline for finishing this task?
questions.description: Some methods like baking soda paste or commercial cleaners require overnight soaking, so timing affects which approach is best.

questions.title: Are there any surfaces or materials you want to avoid harsh chemicals on?
questions.description: Some users have stainless steel, porcelain, or coated surfaces that can be damaged by abrasive or acidic cleaners.
